# Boys to Men Mentorship Camp (Uganda)

> Boys to Men Mentorship Camp is a residential mentorship and life readiness camp for boys and young men aged 8 to 23, based in Uganda and serving families across Uganda and Africa. It is run by Potential Unexplored Ltd (https://potentialunexplored.com), a Ugandan consultancy founded by Banio Luiji Nobert. The camp follows a Discover, Develop, Deploy philosophy, helping boys discover, develop and deploy their potential on the bridge to manhood.

This camp is not connected to the Boys to Men Mentoring Network in the United States or to the Church of Uganda "Boys to Men" programme.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://boystomencamp.com/): overview, upcoming camps and testimony videos
- [About](https://boystomencamp.com/about.html): story, vision, mission and values
- [Intakes](https://boystomencamp.com/intakes.html): age clusters, locations and the December, January and July intake cycle
- [Apply](https://boystomencamp.com/apply.html): how to register a boy for the camp
- [FAQ](https://boystomencamp.com/faq.html): age groups, safety, cost, diaspora applications
- [Mentors](https://boystomencamp.com/mentors.html): the mentors who lead the camp
- [Impact](https://boystomencamp.com/impact.html): stories and results from past camps
- [Blog](https://boystomencamp.com/blog.html): answers to common parenting questions about raising boys
